label: Vincent Ferrer (S. VINCENTII FERRER, PRESBYTERI, Die 5 aprilis)

chants.notes: IN. and GR. citation lines share one merged text block on p554 (y411-435); both rows share this bbox. p494 holds two same-incipit index rows (introitus 'Os iusti' gb 1374 vs graduale 'Os iusti' gb 511, the latter cited as the gradual by Die 2 aprilis on this page) - this row is the introitus, expect gb 1374.
Incipit 'Iustus ut palma' is shared by three chants in April (p508 introitus gb 108, p510 graduale gb 34, p497 offertorium gb 777); this row targets p510/graduale, expect gb 34.

Printed as a single AL line after IN+GR with no engraved Gradual on this page; in Paschaltide the Alleluia replaces the Gradual cited above it, so this fills the Gradual's slot (al1, part_id 20) rather than the ordinary al slot. Same construct as Die 2 aprilis (S. Francisci de Paola) and Die 4 aprilis (S. Isidori) on this page, spelled out in full there.
